werkzeuge.name: Control panel
werkzeuge.satz: Every tool of The Cat & Gun opens from the control panel.

bereiche.satz: The top of the page greets Julie and names the house.
punkte: The greeting changes with the time of day: «Good morning, Julie.», «Good afternoon, Julie.» or «Good evening, Julie.».
The place, the address and the opening hours of the house stand next to it, read from the website.
The date is written in British English.

bereiche.satz: Seven windows open the tools.
punkte: Each window carries the name of a tool: Edit website, Menus & price lists, Inquiries & chat, Brand book, Brand book editor, Sticker editor and Print & feed.
Under each name stands what is waiting in that tool.
If a tool does not answer, the window shows a sentence without a number.
A tool that is not delivered yet shows «In progress».
A click on a window opens the tool.

bereiche.satz: One line shows the visits of today.
punkte: «Today … visits · … pages» shows the visits and pages viewed today.
«Open Visitors» opens the Visitors tool.
Without a number from Visitors, «–» stands in its place.

bereiche.satz: The bar at the top leads to every tool and comes back when you scroll up.
punkte: «Control panel» brings you back to the top of the page.
The keys 1 to 8 open the tools.
«All pieces» shows every printed piece of the house.
«View website» opens the website.
«Guides» leads to the guides.

bereiche.satz: Further down, each tool has its own section, «No. 1 of 8» to «No. 8 of 8».
punkte: The section names what the tool is for in one line.
«How it works» explains in three lines what you do in the tool.
Where the tool gives them, its numbers stand in the section, for example «Sections» and «Pages» for Edit website.
The button at the end opens the tool, for example «Open Edit website».
The section of Print & feed also has «All pieces».

bereiche.satz: The section of Visitors shows numbers of the website.
punkte: It shows «Visits», «Pages viewed» and «Countries».
It says that visits are counted without cookies and never with names.
«Open Visitors» opens the tool.

bereiche.satz: The footer holds the details of the house and the way to help.
punkte: The footer names the house, the address, the opening hours and the phone number.
«View website» opens the website.
If the control panel does not start, a page says so and offers «Reload».
A short tour in five steps shows the page.

werkzeuge.name: Edit website
werkzeuge.satz: With «Edit website» you keep the website of The Cat & Gun up to date yourself: texts, photos, phone, address, opening hours and a notice for guests.

bereiche.satz: The Overview is the start page of the tool.
punkte: At the top it shows if something is waiting in the draft and when the website was last published.
Below that are the jobs that come up most often («Often used»).
At the bottom every page of the website stands as a card with a photo: Home, Menu, Super Juices, Playground, Pool & Bar and Visit.
A card leads to «Menus & price lists».
On the left are the same pages, plus «Phone, address & hours», «Times & prices», «Notice for guests», «Draft & compare» and «Earlier versions».
On the phone, «Sections» at the top opens this list.

bereiche.satz: Texts are changed right next to the page as guests see it.
punkte: Choose a page. On the right is the page the way guests see it.
Click the text you want to change. A field opens on the left, and the page on the right changes as you type.
The search field shows only the lines with the word you type.
If the same text is on several pages, the field offers to change it in all spots.
«As built» brings back the original text.
A whole section can be hidden and shown again later.
The page can be shown the way guests see it on a phone.
Dishes, drinks and prices on the Menu page are locked here. You change them in «Menus & price lists».

bereiche.satz: Click a photo on the page to swap it.
punkte: You can choose from all photos of the website.
«Upload» adds a new photo: at least 900 pixels wide, at most 25 MB, as JPG, PNG or WebP.
The tool makes the sizes for computer and phone.
Screen readers and search engines read the photo description. Write one sentence about what is in the photo.

bereiche.satz: Details that appear on many pages are kept in one place.
punkte: «Phone, address & hours» lists every such detail, and how often and on how many pages it appears.
You change it once, and it is new everywhere, also in the link to call from a phone.
«Where exactly?» lists each spot.
Other times, sizes and durations are under «Times & prices».
Prices come from «Menus & price lists».

bereiche.satz: A notice shows at the top of every page.
punkte: Under «Notice for guests» you write one or two sentences, for example when you are closed for a day.
You can switch the notice on and off and add a link.
With a start and an end date, the notice shows and goes away by itself.
With empty dates, it shows from now on until you switch it off.

bereiche.satz: Nothing goes online by itself. What you save waits in the draft until you publish it.
punkte: As long as something is not saved, the bar at the bottom says so and «Save» lights up.
After saving, a short message shows with «Before/After» and «Undo».
Shortcut: Cmd + S on a Mac, Ctrl + S on Windows.
«Draft & compare» shows every change with the old and the new wording. You can undo each one by itself.
«Publish» puts the draft on the website, texts and photos together, with a short note for the earlier versions.
When it is done, the bar says «Everything is published».

bereiche.satz: Every publish is kept.
punkte: «Earlier versions» lists every publish with its date and note.
«Restore» puts that version in the draft.
It goes on the website only when you publish again.

bereiche.satz: Every message leads to help.
punkte: Every message has a «What to do?» button. It opens the checks page.
The checks page works even when the tool itself does not start.
It tells you what is wrong and what to do.
What you saved is never lost.
«Short tour» shows where things are.

werkzeuge.name: Menus & price lists
werkzeuge.satz: Here you keep the dishes, drinks and prices of The Cat & Gun. The same data makes the PDF for the printer and the menu page of the website.

bereiche.satz: Drinks, Coffee & juices and Kitchen, with the pages, sections and order of the printed menu.
punkte: The menus are on the left. On the right the chosen menu shows as it will be printed.
On the phone the «Menu» button at the top right opens the side panel.
One click on an item shows it in the list and in the menu at the same height, and it flashes briefly.
The menu in the café is printed on boards. A change here is for the next printed menu and for the website. The boards stay as they are.

bereiche.satz: Double-click or the pencil opens an item.
punkte: The item has a name, marks (V, R), a price, a second price line where there are two (Bagel, Focaccia) and a description.
«Show on the menu» is part of the item.
Prices are written like on the menu: «260», «220/GLASS» or «240 | 260».
On the right you see how it will look.

bereiche.satz: Each item has its own buttons.
punkte: Copy makes a new item in the same format.
The eye hides an item for a while, the bin takes it away.
The arrows change the order.
«New item» and «Add item» add an item at the end of a section.
«New section» adds a section.

bereiche.satz: A switch above the preview changes the view.
punkte: «Menu» shows the menu as it will be printed.
«Website» shows the menu page with your draft, the way a guest will see it after publishing.
The «Website» view shows only the menu page.

bereiche.satz: In «Advanced» you design right on the menu.
punkte: One click picks a text, an item, the logo or the footer.
Drag to move. The corners make a part bigger or smaller. It snaps to edges and centres, except with the Alt key held.
«Design» opens on the right: font, size, text style (normal or capitals), colour, alignment, line spacing, space before and after.
A double-click writes straight into the text.
«Menu data» shows the pages of the menu as text.

bereiche.satz: Every change is a draft first. PDF and website change only when you publish.
punkte: «Save» puts the change in the draft. «Undo» takes it back.
Before, after shows each place on the left (today) and on the right (draft), new words marked.
Test PDF prints the draft to look at.
«Publish» prints the PDF, compares it word for word with the data, builds the menu page of the website and only then replaces the old version.
While the website is not online, the new menu page waits in the tool, ready to go online.

bereiche.satz: The last versions stay in the tool.
punkte: «Earlier versions» keeps every published menu.
«Put in the draft» brings one back.
«Original menu» is the menu as it was built.
Until handover the log says «Team The Cat & Gun», without a login.
After handover a login comes first: kitchen and service change the menus and print test PDFs, the manager publishes, brings back earlier versions and switches the website link.

bereiche.satz: Shortcuts and keywords help with daily work.
punkte: ⌘Z undoes, ⌘⇧Z or ⌘Y redoes, also text you wrote.
⌘S saves, also while writing in the menu.
Arrow keys move the chosen part by 0.5 mm, with Shift by 5 mm. Delete hides the chosen part, Esc unselects.
Every message carries a keyword, for example KONFLIKT, PASST or VERBINDUNG. The guide says what each one means.
«Short tour» on the left under «Links» shows in four steps where things are.

werkzeuge.name: Inquiries & chat
werkzeuge.satz: Here you see what guests ask the chat on the website when it has no answer, and you give the chat new answers. The chat works without AI.

bereiche.satz: The start page shows what waits for you.
punkte: At the top, three fields: new inquiries in the inbox, questions without answer, and how many answers the chat has.
Below, the latest inquiries and the latest questions.
On the left the sections: «Inbox», «Questions», «Your answers», «What the chat knows» and «How the chat works».
The number next to a section shows what waits for you. On the phone, «Sections» opens the list.

bereiche.satz: You see the chat the way a guest will see it.
punkte: «Try the chat» at the top right opens a window: four questions to tap, and the chat as a guest sees it on the phone.
Without an answer, the chat offers «Send to the house». Name and contact are optional.
A question sent from here lands in the inbox as an example.
«The chat as on the website» opens a test page with the published answers.
The chat is not built into the website yet.

bereiche.satz: Guests who send a question and leave a contact are in the inbox.
punkte: «All», «New», «Open» and «Done» filter the list. Inquiries are sorted by day.
Opening an inquiry marks it as read. It shows the contact, when it was sent, from which page, and the question.
«Done» marks an inquiry as answered. «Open again» brings it back.
Inquiries are kept for twelve months. The bin button and «Delete for good» delete one when a guest asks for it.

bereiche.satz: Under the question is a sheet with the logo for a reply to one guest.
punkte: Write the reply into the sheet.
«Save reply» (Ctrl+S, on a Mac ⌘S) keeps it with the inquiry.
«Copy text» puts the reply on the clipboard. You send it yourself by phone, message or Instagram.
Nothing is sent from the tool, and no mail program opens.
If two windows save the same inquiry, the second gets «changed in another window». Nothing is overwritten.

bereiche.titel: Questions and answers for every guest
bereiche.satz: Every question guests sent stands here by topic.
punkte: «Questions» shows all questions, without answer, answers by you and with contact.
«Without answer» shows only the questions that still need you.
«Answer for every guest» opens a form for one answer that the chat gives to everyone after «Publish».
«Other ways guests ask» takes other words, with commas, for example toilet, restroom.
«Valid until» ends an answer on a date. Leave it empty for no end.
«Mark as done without answer» is for questions that do not fit the house.
Questions marked «Example» are samples until real ones come in.

bereiche.satz: All answers you wrote stand here as cards.
punkte: «Change» on a card changes the answer.
«Remove» takes it out of the draft. After «Publish» the chat no longer knows it.
«Add an answer» gives the chat an answer before anyone asks.

bereiche.satz: The chat only answers with the lines here.
punkte: Lines come from the website (opening hours, address, phone, menu, drinks, the pool table, the playground, events) and from you.
Tap a line, change the text, «Save». The website itself stays as it is.
«Hidden» stops the chat from saying a line. «As on the website» brings back the original line.
«Valid until» sets a date after which the chat no longer says the line.
«Something new» or «Add a line» adds a line with title, text, area and an optional photo.
The search field searches all areas.
«Ask, like a guest» answers from the draft. The question is not saved.

bereiche.satz: Everything you save goes into the draft first. Guests see it only after «Publish».
punkte: The bar at the bottom shows «Draft: n changes wait».
«Before, after» lists each change: new, changed, removed or hidden.
«Publish» opens a window with the list and a note. «Publish now» writes the answers file of the chat again. The website pages stay as they are.
When it is done: «It is online.» If something goes wrong, the old answers file stays.
«Earlier versions» lists each version with date, number of answers and note. «Original state» holds the answers from the website.
«Put in the draft» changes nothing on the website until you publish.
«How the chat works» shows the way of a question in eight steps, with the numbers of today.

werkzeuge.name: Brand book editor
werkzeuge.satz: The Brand book editor holds the colours, fonts, photos, lines and elements of The Cat & Gun. The Sticker editor, Print & feed and the Brand book take them from here.

bereiche.satz: The editor is built like the other tools.
punkte: On the left: «Colours», «Fonts», «Photos», «Lines» and «Logo & elements», below them «Earlier versions».
At the top right: the Control panel, the guide and «View website».
At the bottom the bar shows what is waiting, with «Before / after», «Save» and «Publish».
On the phone, «Sections» opens the list.

bereiche.satz: All colours of the house stand in their palettes: Print, Super Juices and Website.
punkte: Each card shows the name, what the colour is for and the value.
Tap a colour. In the window, choose a colour of the house or type HEX (like #A8232A) or R, G and B from 0 to 255.
«Use this colour» takes it. «Hide» takes the colour out of use; it stays under «Hidden».
«New colour» adds a colour to a palette.
Every element that wears a colour changes with it.
«Pipette» picks a colour on the screen in Chrome and Edge; in Safari and Firefox it opens the photos of the house.
«Colours from a photo» shows the main colours of a photo. «Offer as a new palette» keeps them. The photo is only read in your browser.

bereiche.satz: Switch «Mode» to «More options» for palettes, shades and contrast.
punkte: «New palette» or «Edit palette»: give it a name and tick its colours.
«Tints and shades» shows four lighter and four darker steps. «Add all nine as a palette» keeps them.
«Contrast check» shows the value for text in one colour on another: 4.5 for normal text, 3 for large titles.
The mode stays as you left it, on this computer.

bereiche.satz: Four uses, each with one font: titles, running text, numbers and titles in print.
punkte: Under «Which font for what», choose a font for a use. The sample changes at once.
Rename a font in its field. «Hide» takes a font out of use, as long as no use needs it.
«Add a font» uploads a font file (WOFF2, WOFF, TTF or OTF, up to 6 MB).
Under «More options» you choose which weights of a font may be used.

bereiche.satz: The photos of the website, each with its title.
punkte: Search with a word. «In use», «Added» and «Hidden» narrow the list.
Tap a photo to change its title, hide it or swap it.
Swapping hides the old photo. It stays under «Hidden».
«Add a photo» takes JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 25 MB, at least 900 pixels on the long side.

bereiche.satz: Name, place, opening hours and the sentences of the house, as the design tools use them.
punkte: Change the title or the text in its field. A counter shows the characters (5,000 is the most).
«New line» adds a line. «Hide» takes it out of use.
Under each line stands where it comes from.
A line may not stay empty.

bereiche.satz: The wordmark, the ampersand, the pool ball and the stickers. Each colour in them is a part.
punkte: Tap an element. Its parts stand on the right, each with its house colour.
Choose another house colour for a part. The picture changes at once.
Under «More options», «Own value» gives a part a colour only in this element. «Back to the house colour» undoes it.
Rename or hide an element in the same window. New elements cannot be added here.

bereiche.satz: Changes wait in a draft. Publishing puts them into every tool.
punkte: «Save» keeps your changes in the draft. A note shows what was saved, with «Undo».
«Before / after» lists every change.
«Publish» shows the list once more, takes an optional note and asks you to confirm.
If someone saved in another window, the editor says so. Nothing is overwritten.
«Earlier versions»: «Bring into draft» puts a version back in the draft. «Original version» is the brand collection as built.
«Discard draft» brings back what is published.
Each note has «What to do?», which leads to the help in the guide.

werkzeuge.name: Brand book
werkzeuge.satz: The Brand book is the brand of The Cat & Gun in one place: photos in the right size, logo files and colour values. It saves nothing and changes nothing.

bereiche.satz: Three parts for every day and the style guide.
punkte: On the left: «Photos», «Logo & files» and «Colour check», below them the style guide.
At the top right: «Control panel», the guide and «View website».
At the bottom: the source of the photos, «Change» and all files of the brand at once.
On the phone, «Sections» opens the parts as a menu.
What you get lands on your computer.

bereiche.satz: All photos of the house are under «Photos».
punkte: Type into the search field, for example «pool», «juice» or «bagel».
Choose portrait or landscape.
Above the photos it says how many fit. «Reset filters» shows all again.
For an Instagram post, choose «Portrait»; then the least is cut away.

bereiche.satz: A click on a photo opens it large, with four ready sizes.
punkte: «Instagram post» is 1080 × 1350, «Story» 1080 × 1920. The crop appears in the picture.
Drag the frame to the part that should show. «Get» takes exactly this crop.
«Website» gets the photo with 2000 pixels on the longest side, «Print» in full size.
Two buttons open the photo in Print & feed.
If a photo is too small for a story, the file name says «upscaled».

bereiche.satz: Everything a designer or a print shop needs.
punkte: The wordmark and the ampersand, each in black for light grounds and in white for dark grounds.
«SVG» stays sharp at any size. «PNG» has a clear background.
The herringbone pattern of the website comes as a tile.
«All files (ZIP)» gets everything at once, with the fonts.
The files are made from the brand book as it is published.

bereiche.satz: The colours stand with name and note: the print pieces, the six Super Juices and the website.
punkte: Click a colour: the value (for example #A8232A for pool table red) is copied.
A click on the RGB line copies the RGB values.
Colours come as CSS, JSON or ASE (for InDesign and Illustrator), fonts as WOFF2 or one ZIP.
Each colour says where it comes from.

bereiche.satz: Check if the colours of a draft from a designer fit The Cat & Gun.
punkte: Drag the draft into the field or press «Choose file»: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 30 MB. For a PDF, save the first page as a picture.
Press «Measure». The colours are measured in the browser. Nothing is sent.
One sentence says how much of the draft is in the colours of the house. Each colour stands next to the closest house colour.
Colours that are not house colours come first, with a red line. Pure black is not a house colour.
«Copy as text» gives the result for an email. «Save result» saves it as a file.
The check measures colours only. It does not judge pictures or words.

bereiche.satz: The style guide shows the brand page by page.
punkte: Press «Style guide» on the left or on the overview.
At the top you jump to each page. «Save as PDF» saves it as a PDF.
Changes are made in the Brand book editor: «Change» at the bottom or «Change in the Brand book editor» above the photos.
After publishing there, the Brand book shows the new state right away in the same browser, otherwise within half a minute.

werkzeuge.name: Sticker editor
werkzeuge.satz: With the Sticker editor you change the stickers of the house, design new ones and get print files. It works without AI.

bereiche.satz: The overview shows the stickers of the house by area.
punkte: «All stickers» shows every sticker. You can search and filter by area.
Favourites stand in front. A sticker can be moved to the front or to the back.
Each card says if the sticker is published, changed or not published yet.
The buttons on a card copy a sticker or get its PDF.

bereiche.satz: The tab «Quick» changes words and colours.
punkte: Change the words of the sticker.
A colour changed here changes every part in that colour.
After a colour change, text that would vanish on the new ground turns black or paper.

bereiche.satz: Click a part of the sticker to change it in the panel «Design».
punkte: Words, font, size, capitals, letter spacing, colour and alignment.
Every part can take its own colour, for example the six dots in the Super Juices oval.
Colours come from the brand palette, as a value or with the pipette.
The pipette works anywhere on the screen in Chrome and Edge; in other browsers it works in the sticker and in uploaded photos.
Colours from an uploaded photo appear in every colour choice.
Drag to move, use the handles to resize or turn. Keys: ⌘Z, ⇧⌘Z, ⌘D and the arrow keys.

bereiche.satz: «More tools» opens the advanced tools.
punkte: Arc text, shapes and lines.
Position in millimetres, lining up and a grid.
Layers, hide and lock.

bereiche.satz: New stickers start from a shape or a sticker of the house.
punkte: «New sticker» starts from a shape: round, oval, square, strip or bubble.
Or copy a sticker of the house and change it.
«Brand elements» adds the pool ball, the wordmark or the ampersand.
«Already used» shows when a motif is already on a sticker.

bereiche.satz: Before printing, the tool checks the sticker.
punkte: «Print check» shows what to fix before printing (margin, resolution, missing text) and what is only a note. On the phone it is in the menu «Print».
«PDF for the printer» has 3 mm bleed, a cut line and the fonts embedded.
A sticker can also be downloaded as a picture or as the working file.
Characters the font does not have, such as emoji, are named by the print check and left out of the PDF.

bereiche.satz: The bar at the bottom works like in the other tools.
punkte: «Save» keeps changes in the draft. They are still there after reloading.
«Before, after» lists the changes. «Earlier versions» brings back an earlier state.
«Publish» makes the print files of the changed stickers.
The print files wait under «Print files» in the overview, ready to download. Print & feed reads them from there.

werkzeuge.name: Print & feed
werkzeuge.satz: Print & feed makes signs, coasters, table cards, posters and Instagram posts from templates of the house, as PDF to print or as a picture. It works without AI.

bereiche.satz: The start page shows what you can make.
punkte: It shows the areas of the house, notices, the Instagram feed and your own designs.
Templates come in kinds such as coasters, beer mats, signs, chalkboards, posters, table cards, labels, cups, placemat, napkin, cup sleeve, banner and Instagram.
The search field searches the templates.
«Blank page» starts an empty design.

bereiche.satz: The printed pieces of the house can be edited as documents.
punkte: «House pieces» shows the pieces in groups.
The pieces of the house also stand first in each kind.
A changed piece is saved under «My designs».
«Work on a copy» and «Back to the original» stand under «Piece of the house».

bereiche.satz: A template opens in the editor.
punkte: Click a text and change it.
The panel «Design» changes font, size and colour.
«Arrange» and position in millimetres place a part.
The toolbar adds text, a photo, a mark, a shape or a frame, and sets ground and pattern.
A design can have a back side and several pages.
Round formats such as beer mats and coasters have a round cut line.

bereiche.satz: The tab «Brand kit» holds the colours, fonts and elements of the Brand book editor.
punkte: Elements such as the pool ball go into the design.
The parts of an element can be recoloured one by one.
Elements go into the PDF as vectors.
Changes from the Brand book editor arrive without reloading.
The views «Photos of the house», «Colours & fonts» and «Brand book» show the photos, colours, fonts and wordmark.

bereiche.satz: Posts and stories are made in the same editor.
punkte: «Phone preview and caption» shows the post on a phone, with a carousel.
Captions are written by hand, with the lines of the house.
A design is saved as a PNG picture for Instagram.

bereiche.satz: Before printing, the tool checks the design.
punkte: «Print check» shows what to fix before printing.
«Save for print» makes a PDF for the print shop with 3 mm bleed.
A photo with too low resolution gets a dpi warning.
The PDF names characters the font does not have.

bereiche.satz: Your designs are kept in the browser.
punkte: «My designs» holds your own designs.
«Release» publishes a design for the areas of the house. «Take back» withdraws it.
If two windows change the same design, the tool reports a conflict and saves the second version as a copy.

werkzeuge.name: Visitors
werkzeuge.satz: Visitors shows who visits the website: from which country and website guests come, on which device, and what they look at. Here you only read.

bereiche.satz: The sections stand on the left.
punkte: «Overview», then «Visits», «Origin» and «Time» for the guests, «Pages», «Trend» and «On the way» for the website, last «How we count».
Under the title of each view you pick the period: 7, 30 or 90 days.
At the top: the Control panel, the guide and «View website». The bar at the bottom names the visits of today.
The first time, a sign offers a «Short tour». It opens again from the left side.

bereiche.satz: Four numbers and the visits per day.
punkte: Visits (next to the period before), pages viewed, minutes per visit and how many guests were on the way.
Cloudflare counts visits and pages viewed. For the other two the real view shows «–» and «not counted by Cloudflare».
Move the mouse over a column: day and number of visits appear.
«Where guests come from» and «Viewed most» show the first places, with a link to the whole list.

bereiche.satz: Where guests come from.
punkte: From the Philippines and from abroad, and the countries. Cloudflare tells the country.
«Came from» names the website that brought the guest: Instagram, Google, Google Maps, Facebook or TravelGO.
«Typed in directly» means the address was typed in, a bookmark or a link from a message.
«Device» tells mobile, tablet and computer apart.

bereiche.satz: When visits start, in Siargao time.
punkte: Four peaks: when most guests come, the busiest day, how many from 6PM and how many on weekends.
«At what time» shows 24 columns, one per hour.
«Weekday and hour» puts both together: the darker a field, the more visits.

bereiche.satz: What is viewed and how visits develop.
punkte: «Pages» lists every page of the website with its views, the most visited on top.
«Trend» puts the chosen period next to the period before.
«Next to the period before» compares visits, pages viewed and pages per visit, with the difference in percent.
«Week by week» sums up Monday to Sunday.

bereiche.satz: A guest is on the way when they tap Call or open the directions.
punkte: Cloudflare does not count these taps. The real view says «Taps are not counted.».
It shows how often the Visit page with the map was opened.
«See the pages» opens «Pages».

bereiche.satz: The tool has test data to show all views.
punkte: «Show test data» switches to test data. Every view marks them as test data.
Only the test data have a list of single visits, the path through the website, places, browser language, time on a page and taps.
«Save as table» saves the visits as a table file (CSV).

bereiche.satz: «How we count» lists what is counted and what is never counted.
punkte: Cloudflare Web Analytics counts the page, the time, the country, the device and the name of the website the guest came from.
Never counted: names, emails and anything a guest types.
No cookies are set. The address of the connection is not used to follow a guest.
The privacy note of the website should name Cloudflare Web Analytics before it is switched on.

offen: Edit website: Die Anleitung nennt den Knopf «As built», Video B zeigt «Back to original». Welche Beschriftung steht heute im Werkzeug?

Vorher/nachher ist je Werkzeug verschieden geschrieben («Before/After» in Edit website, «Before / after» im Brand book editor, «Before, after» in Inquiries & chat); für Menus & price lists und Sticker editor ist der genaue Wortlaut des Knopfs nicht belegt (Anleitung ohne «», Video sagt «Before and after»).
Frühere Fassung zurückholen heisst je Werkzeug anders («Restore», «Put in the draft», «Bring into draft»); für Menus & price lists nennt nur das Video «Put in the draft», die Anleitung keinen Knopf.

Control panel, Tafel Visitors: «Countries and cities of the visits» und «how long they stay». Laut Visitors-Anleitung zählt Cloudflare weder Ort noch Zeit auf einer Seite (nur Testdaten). Nicht übernommen.
Control panel, Tafel Inquiries & chat: «Guests can ask on every page of the website». Der Chat ist auf der Website noch nicht eingebaut. Nicht übernommen.
Kosten: Das Next-Steps-PDF (20.11.2026) nennt sechs Werkzeuge mit 0 PHP. Brand book editor, Sticker editor und Inquiries & chat stehen dort nicht. Für sie ist kein Betrag belegt.

Inquiries & chat: Anleitung sagt «by phone, message or Instagram», Video D «by WhatsApp, mail or Instagram». Testknopf heisst in der Anleitung «Ask, like a guest», im Video «Test a question», im STAND «Test the chat».
Brand book: Anleitung sagt «Two buttons open the photo in Print & feed», Video und STAND nennen «Design in Print & feed». Beschriftung der zwei Knöpfe offen.
Print & feed: Beschriftungen der Vorlagen-Filter (Art, Grösse, Bereich, Grund/Anlass) und der Werkzeugleiste sind nur auf Deutsch im Konzept belegt, nicht wörtlich. Keine Anleitung, kein Video.
Sticker editor: Video-Entwurf spricht von fünf Bereichen, STAND kennt die Stücke sticker bis sticker7 und zuletzt 36 Sticker (Entwurf wartet auf «Publish»). Anzahl Bereiche und Sticker weggelassen.
Sticker editor und Print & feed: keine englische Anleitung vorhanden, Inhalte nur aus STAND, Konzept und Video-Entwurf; Wortlaut einzelner Knöpfe vor Veröffentlichung im Werkzeug prüfen.
Menus & price lists: Desserts, Cookies, Chilled Drinks und das Bagel-Kombi stehen auf der Website, aber nicht im Werkzeug.

Control panel: «Guides» führt heute zur Fusszeile «The guides come with the tools.», nicht zur Academy. Die Sprungmarken der Leiste erscheinen erst ab rund 2500 px, «Today … pages» zeigt «–», Fusszeile «Email and phone: not given yet.»
Upload-Mindestmass: Edit website sagt «at least 900 pixels wide», Brand book editor «at least 900 pixels on the long side».
Menus & price lists: Wer nach der Übergabe «manager», «kitchen» und «service» ist und wie die Anmeldung läuft, ist nicht belegt.
Visitors: Wann Cloudflare Web Analytics eingeschaltet wird und wer den Datenschutzhinweis der Website ergänzt, ist offen.
